!_: scalar-out
-_: scalar-out
@in: scalar-out
@not_strictly_false: scalar-out
@sortByAssociatedKeys: bounded (budgetedSort in charge.go charges the bytes of the keys before it sorts)
_!=_: scalar-out
_%_: scalar-out
_&&_: scalar-out
_*_: scalar-out
_+_: amplifying (the result is charged by size and capped at 1000000: string, bytes and list)
_-_: scalar-out
_/_: scalar-out
_<=_: scalar-out
_<_: scalar-out
_==_: scalar-out
_>=_: scalar-out
_>_: scalar-out
_?_:_: bounded (gives one of its branches)
_[_]: bounded (gives one element)
__not_strictly_false__ [disabled]: scalar-out
_in_ [disabled]: scalar-out
_||_: scalar-out
bool: scalar-out
bytes: bounded (same size as its operand)
cel.@block: bounded (gives its body)
charAt: bounded (one character)
contains: scalar-out
distinct: bounded (no more elements than its operand; budgeted by equality.go)
double: scalar-out
duration: scalar-out
dyn: bounded (gives its operand)
endsWith: scalar-out
flatten: amplifying (budgetedFlatten in equality.go spends one step for each element)
format: amplifying (go-kure/launcher#1462: not bounded yet, the result is refused after it is built)
getDate: scalar-out
getDayOfMonth: scalar-out
getDayOfWeek: scalar-out
getDayOfYear: scalar-out
getFullYear: scalar-out
getHours: scalar-out
getMilliseconds: scalar-out
getMinutes: scalar-out
getMonth: scalar-out
getSeconds: scalar-out
in [disabled]: scalar-out
indexOf: bounded (budgetedSearch in charge.go refuses a search that cel-go would charge over the cost limit before it runs; TestSearchIsRefusedBeforeItRuns)
int: scalar-out
join: amplifying (budgetedJoin in equality.go checks every element before it writes and stops before the buffer passes the cap; TestChargeStopsBeforeTheAllocation, TestChargeFailAfterWorkSweep)
lastIndexOf: bounded (budgetedSearch in charge.go refuses a search that cel-go would charge over the cost limit before it runs; TestSearchIsRefusedBeforeItRuns)
lists.range: amplifying (cel-go caps it at 1000000 elements and charges it by size; TestReplaceGrowth pins the cap)
lowerAscii: bounded (same size as its operand)
matches: bounded (budgetedMatches in charge.go refuses a match that cel-go would charge over the cost limit before it runs; TestMatchesIsRefusedBeforeItRuns)
replace: amplifying (budgetedReplace in charge.go stops before it builds a result over the cap; TestChargeReplaceStopsBeforeTheAllocation)
reverse: bounded (same elements as its operand)
size: scalar-out
slice: bounded (no more elements than its operand)
sort: bounded (budgetedSort in charge.go charges the bytes of the keys before it sorts)
split: bounded (no more bytes than its operand)
startsWith: scalar-out
string: bounded (same size as its operand, or a number)
strings.quote: bounded (at most six times its operand, then charged by the result cap)
substring: bounded (no more bytes than its operand)
timestamp: scalar-out
trim: bounded (no more bytes than its operand)
type: scalar-out
uint: scalar-out
upperAscii: bounded (same size as its operand)
